system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

data_description.dataset_name: MOD13A3.061 Vegetation Indices Monthly L3 Global 1 km SIN Grid

spatial_coverage.region_name: Kubuqi Desert and surrounding terrestrial areas in Inner Mongolia, China
spatial_coverage.coverage: Global terrestrial coverage on a 1 km sinusoidal grid, including the Kubuqi Desert and adjacent arid and semi-arid land surfaces.

analytical_capabilities: Monthly vegetation condition mapping and interannual comparison
Vegetation index time-series analysis at monthly resolution
Seasonal cycle, phenology-window, and growing-season aggregation
Vegetation trend detection and change attribution against gridded covariates
Spatial stratification of vegetation state by terrain, climate zone, or land-cover class

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: NDVI and EVI as dimensionless indices, stored with a scale factor of 0.0001
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Multiply `NDVI` or `EVI` by 0.0001 to obtain physical index values. Screen pixels with `SummaryQA` for routine filtering, or `DetailedQA` when specific quality bits matter. `sur_refl_b01` through `sur_refl_b07` carry the contributing surface reflectances at the same scale, and `ViewZenith`, `SolarZenith` and `RelativeAzimuth` are in degrees with a 0.01 scale. Monthly compositing means a single image already averages within its month, so avoid double-averaging when building seasonal means. Note this collection has no per-pixel `DayOfYear` band, so the exact observation date within a month is not recoverable.

data_description.data_source: NASA LP DAAC at the USGS EROS Center, derived from Terra MODIS
